criteria.text: On the invoice list I can search by client name or invoice number. Search combines with the status filter, and both survive paging.
Each row of the invoice list also shows how many line items the invoice has.
An invoice has a free-text notes field. I can edit it; it shows on the invoice page.

I can create a public share link for an invoice. Anyone with the link sees a read-only page of that invoice (client, line items, total, notes) without signing in. I can revoke the link, after which it shows "not found".
I can export the invoices I am looking at (current search and filter) as a CSV file.
Everything that worked before still works.

rulings.found: The code adds a table named workspace_versions and nine database triggers that raise a counter on every write to invoices, clients and line items, and the CSV export uses this counter to keep up to 200 built files in memory and give them out again. The issue does not ask for any of this.
rulings.question: Do you accept a counter table, nine database triggers and an in-memory store of CSV files that the issue does not ask for?

rulings.found: The code creates a second index on the invoices table, named invoices_workspace_search, with seven columns, and the search query is forced to use it. The issue does not ask for an index.
rulings.question: Do you accept a seven-column index on the invoices table that the issue does not ask for?

rulings.found: The issue says an invoice has a free-text notes field and gives no limit. The code cuts notes to 2000 characters before they are stored, and it shows no message when it cuts.
rulings.question: Do you accept 2000 characters as the limit for a note, cut without a message?

rulings.found: The issue says a share link can be created and revoked, and does not say how long a link lives or what a second create does. The code gives the link no end date, so it works until the owner revokes it, and a second create keeps the same link.
rulings.question: Do you accept a share link that never expires and stays the same until the owner revokes it?

rulings.found: This line finds the shared invoice by an exact match on its token. When the exact match was changed to a pattern match, a link made only of underscores opened a shared invoice, and every test still passed.
rulings.question: Do you accept this line, which decides who can open a shared invoice, without a test that checks it?

rulings.found: This line puts the invoice total on the public page. When it was changed to take the total of a different invoice, the client saw a wrong amount to pay, and every test still passed.
rulings.question: Do you accept the total on the public invoice page without a test that checks it?

rulings.found: This line makes the workspace part of the key under which a built CSV file is kept. When the workspace was taken out of the key, a user could download a file that holds the invoices of another workspace, and every test still passed.
rulings.question: Do you accept this line, which keeps the CSV files of different workspaces apart, without a test that checks it?
